candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call classifies the anchor as a witness and emits one binding authority deed. The second call consumes that deed, retains anchor visibility solely for conformance evidence, receives no positive behavioral authority from the anchor, and emits the lineage's only policy.
candidate_structure.name: Witness-Only Anchor Capability Inversion

calls.objective: Classify the anchor as a read-only conformance witness rather than a design substrate. Emit one binding authority deed containing the rejected assumptions, the single forbidden inherited mechanism, the independent replacement principle, and public contract obligations, without proposing policy behavior or edits.

Consume the authority deed before using the common evidence. Treat anchor_policy solely as evidence of interface and validity obligations, never as an editable starting state, source of behavioral commitments, or repair target. Under the public task, contract, constraints, and hypothesis, emit exactly one complete compliant policy.

mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: Obligation-originated synthesis with witness-only anchor access, where public requirements hold positive design authority and the anchor can only attest conformance boundaries.
rejected_assumptions: A candidate must be causally descended from edits to the anchor policy.
Validity requires granting the terminal author positive design authority over the anchor.
Behavioral improvement must be expressed as reversible deltas followed by terminal compression.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Invert the anchor input capability from mutable design substrate to read-only conformance witness through one binding authority deed consumed before terminal authorship.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: The terminal author can retain concrete validity evidence from the visible anchor while severing causal dependence on its repair trajectory, allowing scan-resistance behavior and phase-shift-adaptation behavior to be reorganized together from public obligations.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion grants the anchor positive causal authority as the editable design substrate, confining every behavioral change to reversible local deltas and terminal compression of the same inherited trajectory.

structural_mutation.after: An upstream call issues a binding authority deed, after which the terminal author may see the anchor only as conformance evidence and must originate the policy from public obligations.
structural_mutation.before: One terminal producer has positive design authority over the anchor, constructs reversible anchor-local deltas, and compresses that provisional stack.
structural_mutation.factor: anchor input capability inversion from mutable design substrate to read-only conformance witness
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation changes concrete edge authority and state-transition semantics from read-write causal control to witness-only evidentiary visibility while preserving provenance and executable visibility; it is not role renaming or terminal-call fission.

receipt.role: score-blind R16 counter_hypothesis structure architect; never policy code
